Let me check for any further subtypes (classes implementing the Drupal sub-interface or extending the concrete list) across all member projects, and confirm the other PHP-less projects have nothing.

Both PHP-capable member projects checked; laravel-framework has zero references, and the only subtypes live in drupal. The false-positive hits (UserNameValidator, FileValidationEvent, UnprocessableHttpEntityException, InvalidEntityException) are docblock/type-hint mentions, not declarations. The actual subtypes of the Symfony interface are the Drupal sub-interface and its concrete list class. (Go/Python/TS projects can't implement a PHP interface.)
